bottleneck.name: Marin Avenue at Shattuck Avenue / The Circle

_provenance.methodology: v4.11 ΔT — Standard 1 passes (80 ≥ 15). Standard 3 zone=vhfhsz (HAZ_CLASS=3, CAL FIRE FHSZ point-in-polygon). Standard 4: project_vehicles = 80 × 1.9 × 0.90 = 136.8 (rounded 137); bottleneck eff_cap = 900 vph (HCM two-lane @20mph) × 0.35 (VHFHSZ degradation) = 315 vph; ΔT = (137 / 315) × 60 = 26.06 min; threshold = 45 min safe_egress_window × 0.05 max_project_share = 2.25 min. ΔT >> threshold → DISCRETIONARY.
_provenance.notes: Canonical Stage 1 DISCRETIONARY golden — exercises VHFHSZ + two-lane bottleneck + the 0.35 hazard degradation factor. ΔT is ~11.6× the threshold, demonstrating that even a moderate-size project in VHFHSZ fails Standard 4 with margin. The 'fastest exit also fails' pattern: all 13 paths produced flagged outcomes (paths 1-9 via Marin Ave bottleneck at delta_t=26.06, paths 10-13 via alternate exit at delta_t=20.85, both above 2.25 threshold).
